personas.name: Stressed Executive
personas.jtbd: When I'm overwhelmed with work stress and tension, I want to book a massage quickly and easily, so I can find relief without adding more stress to my schedule.
goals: Relieve chronic neck and shoulder tension from desk work
Find a regular wellness routine that fits my schedule
Book appointments quickly without phone calls
Disconnect from work during treatment time
frustrations: Don't have time to call and schedule
Hard to find availability that works with meetings
Want to know exactly what I'm getting before I book
Previous spas felt impersonal or rushed
behaviors: Books everything online or via app
Reads reviews before trying new services
personas.quote: I need a place where I can truly disconnect and reset. My body is screaming for attention but my calendar is packed.

scenarios.name: Emergency Stress Relief
scenarios.description: After a particularly stressful week, needs to book a same-day or next-day appointment

scenarios.name: Monthly Maintenance
scenarios.description: Setting up recurring monthly massage appointments as part of wellness routine

personas.name: Self-Care Enthusiast
personas.jtbd: When I want to treat myself or celebrate a special occasion, I want to find the perfect spa treatment that makes me feel pampered and rejuvenated, so I can maintain my self-care practice.
goals: Find effective anti-aging and skincare treatments
Discover new wellness services to try
frustrations: Hard to tell which facial is right for my skin type
Unclear pricing - hate surprises at checkout
Want to see real results, not just relaxation
Generic treatments that don't address my specific concerns
behaviors: Follows wellness influencers on social media
Books packages for friends and family as gifts
Leaves detailed reviews after positive experiences
personas.quote: Self-care isn't selfish - it's essential. I want a spa that understands my specific skin and wellness goals.

scenarios.name: Birthday Celebration
scenarios.description: Planning a spa day with friends for her birthday

scenarios.name: Skin Concern
scenarios.description: Seeking treatment for a specific skin issue (aging, acne, dryness)

personas.name: Active Athlete
personas.jtbd: When I'm training hard or recovering from an injury, I want to find a massage therapist who understands sports recovery, so I can perform better and avoid injuries.
goals: Address specific muscle issues from training
Improve flexibility and range of motion
frustrations: Most spa therapists don't understand athletic needs
Generic massages that don't address problem areas
Hard to find therapists with sports massage experience
Want targeted treatment, not just relaxation
behaviors: Trains for marathons, triathlons, or competitive sports
Prefers deep tissue and sports-specific techniques
personas.quote: I need someone who can work on my IT band and knows what I mean when I say my piriformis is tight.

scenarios.name: Pre-Event Prep
scenarios.description: Getting ready for a marathon or major competition

scenarios.name: Injury Recovery
scenarios.description: Recovering from a running injury or muscle strain
